messages:
devlin: Customer (acme-inc) reports intermittent decrypt failures after our scheduled CMK rotation on their Private deployment (custom key store + HSM). Only affects svc-dataflow workers in eu-west-1. Proxy logs show AccessDenied on Decrypt. CloudTrail entries reference alias/acme-main-v2. Any ideas?

maria: Can you paste the CloudTrail event id and sample scrubbed logs? Also, do their SDK calls include the encryption context? Missing context is an easy silent breaker.

devlin: CloudTrail event id: 8a3f2b1c-9d4e-4f2b-b2f4-9d7e2a0c6f11. From proxy: "Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException; keyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01". Customer says restarting svc-dataflow temporarily fixes it.

carter: Two quick suspects: stale grant tokens cached by the client, or the client calling Decrypt without the exact encryption context used for GenerateDataKey. With custom keystores/HSM we also sometimes see brief HSM proxy conn issues during rotation — check network logs.

jun: Confirmed: after a restart, error rate drops to zero for ~30m then returns. We did an alias swap as part of rotation (alias -> new-key).

maria: alias swaps + cached envelope keys on the app are classic. If the app keeps an in-memory data key or cached grant token referencing the old key, Decrypt will fail when KMS refuses usage without the token. Also check whether they use GrantToken header (x-amz-grant-token) in their SDK; grant tokens are short-lived.

devlin: Here's the SDK call pattern they use (scrubbed):

```
// node client pseudocode
const params = {
  CiphertextBlob: ciphertextBuffer
  // note: no encryptionContext present here in logs
};
kms.decrypt(params).promise();
```

carter: If they generated the data key with an encryptionContext like {customerId: "acme"} and then call Decrypt without it, KMS will reject. Repro locally with aws cli:

```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob --encryption-context customerId=acme --region eu-west-1
```

If that works but decrypt without the context fails, that's the issue.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: noticed kms-proxy v2.4.1 rollout to private-eu-west at 2026-03-16T03:12Z (by @infra), no rollbacks.

maria: Action items: (1) ask customer to confirm encryption context used at GenerateDataKey and include same at Decrypt; (2) collect full CloudTrail event JSON and proxy logs around the Decrypt event (scrub secrets); (3) confirm whether client sends grant tokens and if they survive restarts; (4) check HSM proxy metrics during the rotation window.

devlin: I'm opening INFRA ticket INFRA-7682 to get eng-runtime to trace grant token handling and kms-proxy HSM connectivity. Also asking customer for a minimal repro (ciphertext blob + exact SDK call with headers).

carter: Temporary mitigation for customer: restart all svc-dataflow processes (flush cached envelope keys) or perform an alias rollback until we verify the flow. Prefer restart if they want lower blast radius.

jun: Sending scrubbed CloudTrail + app logs to the ticket now. Thanks. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll join the ticket and run a quick key-policy + grant audit. If we see mismatched encryption context or dropped x-amz-grant-token headers in the proxy, we'll push a hotfix.

devlin: Thanks team — I'll keep this thread updated as INFRA ticket progresses.
